notes: These selectors target the LINE Chrome extension (ophjlpahpchlmihnnnihgmmeilfjmjjc). Nine keys were verified against a live DOM; search_input / send_button / message_author keep generic fallbacks.
If LINE ships an extension update and a selector breaks, fix it without code changes:
1) Open the LINE extension window in Chrome, then open DevTools (right-click > Inspect).
2) Inspect the broken element and pick a stable selector (prefer role/aria/data-testid > class > tag).
3) Add an override with the same key in ~/.config/line-chrome/selectors.json,
or pass --selector key=value on the CLI for a one-off override.
4) Run `python3 cli.py diagnose` to confirm every selector matches.
Selector priority: CLI --selector > user override (~/.config/line-chrome/selectors.json) > this file.
